segments.oily: One reviewer with oily skin says the product made it feel more manageable and lightweight rather than greasy.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report improved hydration, repaired barrier and reduced texture/dullness, with one saying it helped her skin through cold months and another citing brighter, more alive skin.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin describe a lightweight, non-greasy feel that controls T-zone oiliness while still hydrating and plumping fine lines.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers report no fragrance irritation and, in one long-term case, no breakouts and visible healing of previous product-caused damage, though skin type is described as very reactive.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers (late 30s to 40s and GenX) report softened fine lines, plumping, firmness and a brighter complexion, though a few in this group saw no visible change despite regular use.

concerns.aging: Most reviewers focused on fine lines and wrinkles report visible softening, plumping and a firmer, more youthful look, sometimes after several weeks; a minority say they noticed no real anti-aging effect despite consistent use.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers report the serum leaves skin hydrated, plumped and less dull, with effects felt immediately after application and lasting through the day for some.
concerns.redness: One reviewer specifically notes less redness with continued use; no other reviewer reports increased redness or irritation.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer describes the serum as having repaired a damaged, textured skin barrier and made it part of her permanent routine.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports faded dark spots and more even tone; another reports improved, more even skin color.
concerns.blemishes: A small number of reviewers with acne-prone or breakout-prone skin report clearer skin and no new breakouts after extended use, though the brand is not marketed for acne and results took months to appear.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily or combination skin say the serum does not add greasiness and helps make oiliness feel more manageable through the day.

aspects.libelle: No visible improvement for some users

extraits.texte: I am 40 and I have combination skin, with a few fine lines on my forehead. My T zone gets oily throughout the day. This serum is lightweight and absorbs very quickly. It has a silky texture and is non-greasy. I'm sensitive to fragrances, but I didn't notice one with this serum. My skin feels refreshed and tightened after using this product. The area on my forehead that has fine lines also looks "plumped", as the lines are less visible. I've used various serums throughout the years, but this one definitely stands out. Most of them leave my skin feeling oily. This one doesn't. The results are visible and I can feel the difference after applying this serum.
